BrochureContent.Content: Welcome to No. 1B Peters Square, an exceptional three-bedroom townhouse located in one of Wexford's most sought-after and established residential addresses, just a short stroll from Wexford town centre.  Beautifully renovated and thoughtfully upgraded in recent years, this outstanding home has been finished to an exceptional standard and boasts an impressive C BER rating. Presented in immaculate turnkey condition, the interiors are tastefully decorated in a timeless neutral palette, creating a bright, elegant living environment ready for immediate occupation. Originally dating from the early 1900s, the property effortlessly blends the charm and character of its period origins with the comforts of modern living. Original fireplaces, high ceilings and generous proportions have been carefully preserved and complemented by quality contemporary finishes, including a smart electric heating system, underfloor and wall insulation, a bespoke modern kitchen, premium flooring and a stunning open-plan living and dining space designed for today's lifestyle. Extending to approximately 108 sq.m. (1,163 sq.ft.), the well-planned accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, stylish kitchen, spacious open-plan living/dining area, three generously sized bedrooms, a contemporary shower room, separate guest WC and a substantial attic providing excellent storage potential.  The location is second to none, with every conceivable amenity just moments from your doorstep. Wexford's vibrant Main Street and Quays are within easy walking distance, along with an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, boutiques, supermarkets, schools, churches and both bus and rail services. Some of County Wexford's finest beaches, including Curracloe, Rosslare Strand and St. Helen's Bay, are all within a short drive, while Rosslare Europort is approximately 20 minutes away. Dublin City and Dublin Airport are easily accessible in approximately two hours via the N11/M11 and N25 road network. Offering an enviable combination of period elegance, contemporary comfort and unrivalled convenience, No. 1B Peters Square represents a rare opportunity to acquire a beautifully restored home in the heart of Wexford. Properties finished to this standard in such a prime town-centre setting seldom come to the market, making this a truly exceptional opportunity.  VIEWING HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
